policies.title: Belgian ordinary passports: named advance visitor-visa routes
policies.summary: Current Belgian guidance establishes advance embassy issuance for these ordinary Belgian-passport visitor routes.
conditions: LY: an invitation is required and the application is made at the Libyan Embassy in Brussels; the visa must identify the land border used where applicable. SY: apply in principle at the Syrian Embassy in the country of residence; individual travellers without a visa are generally turned back. CG: apply before departure at the Congo Embassy in Brussels.
Purpose, invitation, route, document, carrier and final-admission conditions remain applicable.

policies.title: Belgian ordinary passports: Djibouti electronic visitor visa
policies.summary: Belgian guidance records a required pre-departure Djibouti eVisa route and says airport visa issuance is no longer available.
conditions: Obtain the visa online via eVisa before travel; the Belgian guidance says arrival visas at Djibouti airport are no longer possible.
Work, residence, special documents, carrier rules and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Belgian ordinary passports: named visitor visas issued at arrival
policies.summary: Current Belgian guidance identifies border-issued visitor visas for these ordinary Belgian-passport routes.
conditions: IQ: ordinary-passport travellers who are not journalists or NGO employees may in principle obtain a visa on entry; Belgium prefers advance Embassy issuance. TM: a Migration Service letter of invitation enables arrival issuance; without it, tourist and transit visas are issued by the Turkmen Embassy in Brussels. CI: Abidjan-airport issuance requires Snedai pre-enrolment approval, with at least two working days processing.
Online preapproval or invitation followed by border issuance is visa_on_arrival, not evisa. Purpose, route, carrier and final-admission conditions remain applicable.

unresolved.reason: Belgian guidance says Belgians need a visa but notes uncertainty whether Taliban authorities recognise visas issued by Afghanistan's Belgian Embassy. It does not establish a usable current issuance point; fallback visa_required remains unpromoted.
